jq.q1:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and ((.title | ascii_downcase | contains("security")) or (.body | ascii_downcase | contains("security"))))] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q4:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.is_pr)] | group_by(.user) | map({user: .[0].user, count: length}) | sort_by(-.count) | .[0] | "\(.user) \(.count)"' issues.json
```
jq.q5:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and .is_pr == false and .comments > 5) | .number] | sort' issues.json
```
jq.q7:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.labels | index("bug") != null))] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q9:
```
jq 'group_by(.user) | map(select(any(.is_pr == true) and any(.is_pr == false))) | length' issues.json
```
jq.q10:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and .is_pr == false) | .comments] | (add / length) as $avg | ($avg * 100 | round) / 100' issues.json
```

aethershell.q1:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.state == "open" && (x.title | lower() | contains("security") || x.body | lower() | contains("security"))) | len()
```
aethershell.q3:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.state == "closed") | map(fn(x) => x.comments) | sum()
```
aethershell.q4:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.is_pr) | group("user") | sort_by("Count", "desc") | first()
```
aethershell.q5:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.state == "open" && !x.is_pr && x.comments > 5) | map(fn(x) => x.number) | sort()
```
aethershell.q6:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | map(fn(x) => x.labels) | flatten() | unique() | len()
```
aethershell.q7:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.state == "open" && (x.labels | any(fn(label) => label == "bug"))) | len()
```
aethershell.q9:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | group("user") | where(fn(g) => g.Group | any(fn(x) => x.is_pr) && g.Group | any(fn(x) => !x.is_pr)) | len()
```
aethershell.q10:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(x) => x.state == "open" && !x.is_pr) | map(fn(x) => x.comments) | avg() | round(2)
```
